build_irf_spade_module: build an IRF+SPADE module with depthwise conv and segmentation mask support
build_irf_spade_pwl_module: build an IRF+SPADE module with pointwise-linear conv and resized mask output
build_fbnetv2_model_from_arch: build an FBNetV2 model from an architecture definition with irf_spade blocks
test_irf_spade_forward_pass: test the IRF+SPADE module forward pass with data and segmentation mask inputs
test_cbr_fusion_on_irf_spade: test CBR fusion on an FBNetV2 model with irf_spade blocks using FX or graph mode
